Carrier: Ambetter. Plan type: HMO. Period: 2026-01-01.

27 benefits are placed in CARIN SBC benefit categories. 3 benefits have no code in the SBC benefit category code system and are listed, by identity only, in the bps-unmapped-benefit extension.

extension.valueString: Health Net of CA: Silver 94 Ambetter HMO | Beginning on or after 01/01/2026 | Coverage for: All Covered Members | Plan Type: HMO
What is the out-of-pocket limit for this plan? $1,400 member/$2,800 family per calendar year.
Primary care visit to treat an injury or illness: $5 copay/visit; Out-of-Network Provider: Not covered
Diagnostic test (x-ray, blood work): Lab/X-ray-$10 copay/visit
Specialty drugs (Tier 4): 10% coinsurance up to $150 per prescription. (The document also prints a $150 per-prescription cap; this file carries only the 10% coinsurance.)
Outpatient surgery - Facility fee: Hospital/ASC-10% coinsurance. Physician/surgeon fees: 10% coinsurance
Emergency room care: Facility-$50 copay/visit. Copay waived if admitted into the hospital.
Hospital stay - Facility fee: 10% coinsurance. Physician/surgeon fees: 10% coinsurance
Mental health outpatient services: Office visit-individual therapy session-$5 copay/visit. Inpatient services: 10% coinsurance
Childbirth/delivery professional services: 10% coinsurance. Childbirth/delivery facility services: 10% coinsurance
Home health care: $3 copay/visit. Limited to 100 visits per calendar year.
Rehabilitation services: $5 copay/visit. Habilitation services: $5 copay/visit
Skilled nursing center: 10% coinsurance. Durable medical equipment: 10% coinsurance. Hospice services: No charge
Children's eye exam: No charge. Children's glasses: No charge. Children's dental check-up: No charge.
Services Your Plan Generally Does NOT Cover: Chiropractic care. Other Covered Services: Acupuncture-covered when medically necessary
